prompt: Build an assembly of two identical plates held apart by a spacer block. Make a part Plate: a 60 × 40 × 5 mm plate (X × Y × Z) with one corner at its origin. Make a part Spacer: a 20 × 20 × 10 mm block with one corner at its origin. Place them as instances: Bottom, the Plate at the origin, grounded; Spacer, the Spacer with its corner at (20, 10, 5), centred on the bottom plate; and Top, a second instance of Plate with its corner at (0, 0, 15), resting on the spacer. Model the plate once and place it twice. Nothing may overlap.
